name: @spences10/pi-team-mode
description: Experimental persistent Pi teammate coordination with groups, artifacts, and mailboxes
author: Scott Spence <me@scottspence.com>

scripts.build: pnpm --filter "$npm_package_name^..." run build:self && pnpm run build:self
scripts.build:self: rm -rf dist && vp exec tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/db/migrations && cp src/db/migrations/*.sql dist/db/migrations/ && node scripts/generate-schema-snapshot.mjs dist/db/migrations dist/db/schema.sql
scripts.check: pnpm --filter "$npm_package_name^..." run build:self && pnpm run check:self
scripts.test: pnpm --filter "$npm_package_name^..." run build:self && pnpm run test:self
scripts.test:release: pnpm run check:self && pnpm run test:self && pnpm run coverage:self && pnpm run test:pack
scripts.coverage: pnpm --filter "$npm_package_name^..." run build:self && pnpm run coverage:self
